fields.summary_ko.0: Seagate Technology (STX) achieved a 91.2% return over the one-year period through November 16, 2026, significantly outperforming the S&P 500's 11.4%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Seagate's operating margin for the quarter ending October 3, 2025 improved to 26.9% from 18.6% year-over-year, with adjusted gross margin reaching a record 40.1% as of October 28.
fields.summary_ko.2: Data center revenue for the quarter ending October 2, 2026 was $3.4 billion, representing 81% of total revenue.
